contexts.text: Oil () = the Holy of love.

Oil of olive was employed for the anointings and the lamps, because it represented all the Celestial, consequently all the good of love and of charity; for the oil is the essential itself of the tree, and as it were its soul; as the Celestial or the good of love... is the essential itself or soul itself of faith. Hence the representation. AC 2162:14.
Fine flour with oil and frankincense = all things of charity... Oil = the Celestial thereof.
The affections of truth and good are signified by fine flour, honey, and oil ().
Oil, because fat, = the Celestial itself.
The tree of oil = the good of the interior man.
Oil = good.
Kings were anointed, because the oil with which they were anointed signified good. Explained.
The prudent virgins taking oil in their vessels = that [there was] good in their truths; thus charity in their faith.
To anoint with oil () = to infill with good.
Oil () = the good from which are these things.
He poured oil upon the head of (the statue) () = holy good; (for) oil = the Celestial of love, or good... (This rite) signified that truth was not without good, but from good...
There are two universal kinds of good: the good of faith, and the good of love. (The former) is signified by the drink-offering, and (the latter) by the oil. AC 4581.
The oil (in the meat-offering) = love to the Lord.
He poured oil upon (the statue) () = the Divine good of love. Explained.

Those who were foolish took their lamps, but took no oil with them = that they had not the good of charity in their truths; Oil = the good of charity and of love. But the prudent took oil in their vessels with their lamps = that they had the good of charity and of love in their truths.
A cruse of oil () = charity and love.
To make the head fat with oil () = to gift with the good of love.
For oil = good. AC 5620:4. AC 5620:8.
Oil () = the good of celestial love.
Poured in oil and wine = performed the works of love and charity. ( = the good of love and the good of faith. AC 9057:2.)
Oil = the good of charity; thus lamps without oil = the truths of faith without the good of charity.
By oil is signified the good of love.

To have oil in their lamps = to have the good of charity in the truths of faith; and not to have oil in their lamps = to have the truths of faith and not in them the good of charity. AC 9182:11. AC 9369:end.

The horn of a son of oil () = the good of faith of that Church from the good of love... A son of oil = the external good of love of the Celestial Kingdom. The Celestial Kingdom... is called an olive tree, or oliveyard, because oil = the good of celestial love.
Oil () = the good of love. References.
Oil, which is of the press, = good from which is truth. References.
The wood of oil () = celestial good.
Oil for the luminary () = the internal good which is in mutual love and in charity; (for) oil = the good of love. Explained. AC 9474.
The wood of oil (of which the cherubs in the Temple were made) = the good of love.
The good of charity by which the Spiritual Heaven is illuminated in the truths of faith, is signified by the oil of olive, and the luminary.

Let them take for thee oil of olive () = the good of charity and of faith; (for) the oil of olive = the good of celestial love; but here the good of spiritual love, which is the good of charity towards the neighbour, and the good of faith. That this good is here signified by the oil of olive is because it was for the luminary... by which is signified the Spiritual Heaven... Oil, and the olive tree, in the Word, = both celestial good and spiritual good; celestial good, when the Celestial Kingdom or Church is treated of; and spiritual good when the Spiritual Kingdom or Church is treated of.
That oil, and also the olive = good. Illustrated.

Oil in the lamps = the good of love and of charity in the truths of faith. The virgins who took lamps and not oil = those who hear the Word, read it, and say that they believe, and yet on that account do nothing of good; and if they do it, it is not from the love of good or truth, but from the love of self or of the world.
Oil () = good.
Hence inauguration to represent was done by oil, which in the spiritual sense is the good of love.
The oil of holiness with which Jehovah hath anointed him () = the Divine good of the Divine love. AE 375:20.

They anointed themselves and others not with the oil of holiness... but with common oil, for the reason that this oil = the gladness and happiness which is of the good of love; but the oil of holiness = the Divine good. AE 375:24.
Cakes of unleavened things mingled with oil () = the purification of the middle Celestial. Explained.
And wafers of unleavened things anointed with oil () = the Celestial in the external man. Explained.
Oil () = the good of love. - a, representative of the Divine good in the Lord; (for) oil = the good of love; and, in the supreme sense, the Divine good of the Divine love in the Lord. AC 10066.
Oil () = celestial good. References.
No oil upon the meat-offering of the sacrifice of sin, because oil = the good of love...
a. The preparation of the oil of anointing = the quality of love in worship.
Oil = good.
The oil of anointing = celestial good, which is the Divine good of the Lord's Divine love in the Inmost Heaven. (Its composition Described, Explained.) AC 10254:3. AC 10254:end.

Oil of olive () = the Lord's Divine celestial good; (for) oil = good, both celestial and spiritual; and an olive (fruit) = celestial love. Hence oil of olive = the celestial good of love; or, what is the same, celestial good. It is said, the Lord's Divine celestial good, because all good, which is essentially good in the Heavens, is from the Lord's Divine. Explained.

By the preparation of the oil of anointing is described the Divine good of the Lord's Divine love in His Divine Human; and, in the relative sense, the good of love with man from the Lord... (Thus) the preparation of the oil of anointing involves also the generation and formation of the good of love with man by the Lord; consequently, that the good of love is formed through the truths of the Church which are from the Word; first, through the external ones; and then through more and more interior ones... and that thus first the external man, and then the interior one is successively imbued with them. Explained.
It shall be the oil of anointing of holiness () = a representative of the Lord as to the Divine Human. Explained. AC 10285. AC 10349.
Oil = internal good. References.
The oil and wine (of the Samaritan) = good and its truth. AR 316:4.
The oil (of the virgins) = the good of love. ( = the good of charity. DP 328:9.) ( = love and charity. AR 433.) ( = good. CL 44:end.) TCR 606.
Oil = the good of love.

Hurt not the oil and the wine () = that it is provided by the Lord that the holy goods and truths which lie hidden interiorly in the Word be not violated and profaned. Oil = the good of love... thus oil = holy good. AE 375.
By oil is meant fire, and thus love.

Hence celestial love, which is love to the Lord, is signified by the oil with which all the holy things of the Church were anointed. The oil which was called the oil of holiness was made from olives and from spices mixed together.
Oil () = the good of love. AR 779:2. Illustrated.
Oil = all that which is essential; for oil is the essence of the tree, thus the life of the tree...
Oil = the good from which is truth. References.
Asher shall dip his foot in oil () = natural delight; oil = delight. ( = the good of love. AE 438:5.)
Oil = celestial love itself.
Oil = the Divine good of the Divine love.
The oil (of the virgins) = the good of love. AE 252:8. AE 274:end. AE 840:3. ( = the good of charity. AE 250:7.) ( = the good of love and of charity. AE 675:6.)
The wood of oil = the good of love.
Oil out of the flint of rock () = spiritual good also through truths.
The oil (on the meat-offering) = the good of celestial love. AE 324:15. AE 491:3.
The oil (of anointing) = celestial good, or the good of love to the Lord.
In the oil of anointing the oil of olive was the primary thing...
All (these) things were inaugurated by oil and by blood... because oil = the Divine good of the Divine love.
Rivers of oil () = truths proceeding from good.
Oil () = the good of the spiritual man.
Oil () = good in the internal man. ( = good. AE 375:30.)
Oil () = the good of the internal man.
Oil of olive, and honey () = the Church as to the good of love and its delight.

That oil = the good of love, may be especially evident from the anointings... for all things of the Church were inaugurated by it... Everyone can see that the oil itself does not sanctify, but that which is signified by the oil, which is the good of love to the Lord from the Lord; and therefore when they were anointed they from that moment represented; for the oil induced a representation of the Lord and of the good of love from Him; for (this) is the Holy itself of Heaven and the Church; for all the Divine inflows through it...
The cause of the representation of what is holy by oil is this: the Lord alone as to the Divine Human is the Anointed of Jehovah... and therefore oil was employed to induce the representations...
These things have been said in order that it may be known that oil = the good of love. Illustrated.
To anoint with oil () = to gift with the good of love. AE 475:9.
Must and oil () = truth and good.
Must and oil () = the truth and good of the Church. ( = truth and its delight. AE 922:end.)
The inauguration of the Spiritual is meant by a horn of oil ()... and a son of oil = truth from good.
Oil () = good.
Thou makest fat my head with oil () = wisdom which is from good. ( = through the good of love. AE 727:2.)
To suck oil out of the flint of rock = to be imbued with good through the truths of faith. Oil = spiritual good and delight. AE 411:7. ( = the delight of spiritual love. AE 619:9.)
To carry down oil into Egypt () = to pervert the goods of the Church by reasonings from scientifics. AE 419:18. AE 654:58.
As oil = the good of love to the Lord and the good of charity towards the neighbour, the Lord (mentioned it in the parable of the virgins).
As oil = the good of love and of charity, the Lord (mentioned it in the parable of the Samaritan).
As oil = the good of love and of charity, and as those who are spiritually sick are healed by this, the disciples anointed many with oil, and healed them ().

(Thus) oil = celestial good and spiritual good; or the good of love to the Lord, and the good of charity towards the neighbour; the oil of anointing, the good of love to the Lord from the Lord; and the oil for lamps, the good of charity from the Lord towards the neighbour.
The firstfruits of oils () = the externals of good.
The oil (of the Samaritan) = the good of love. AE 962:6.
The oil with which (kings were anointed on the forehead and hand) = the good of love, Explained.
Oil () = the good of love in the spiritual man.
Oil, in the Word, = the good of love. AE 638:5.
The oil from which was the fire of the flame in the lamps = the Divine love.
Oil () = the good of internal affection.
Corn, and oil () = the goods of the Church.
Oil () = spiritual good, or that of the internal man. AE 619:11.
Not to be anointed with oil () = not to enjoy any good and the derivative delight.
To anoint with the oil of joy () = to unite Himself by victories in temptations.

With the oil of holiness I have anointed him () = the Lord as to the Divine Human, and the union with the Divine Itself... and this union is meant by, to be anointed with the oil of holiness; for the oil of holiness = the Divine good of the Divine love; and to be anointed = to be united to the Divine truth which was of the Lord's Human in the world.
Oil () = evils from love.
To buy oil () = to procure for themselves the good of love after death.
In the horn of a son of oil; oil = (the Spiritual Church) which had truths from the good of charity.
Not mollified with oil () = not amended by repentance, and tempered by good.
The oil of anointing of holiness = the Divine love; and (the spices in it) = the Divine wisdom...

Wine and oil () = worship from truths and goods which are from a celestial origin, profaned... Oil = good from a celestial origin... Oil, when there is meant the oil of anointing of holiness, = the good of celestial love; but when there is meant the oil with which they anointed themselves in the festivities, it = the good of spiritual love.
In the Third Heaven there are especially trees from the fruits of which drop oils.
